Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

5096042277475.baseName: Christmas wreath - Seasonal wall wreath - Black door hanger and 135 branches, pine-style greenery for a hallway or mantel - 60 cm
5096042277475.variantName: Christmas wreath - Seasonal wall wreath - Black door hanger and 135 branches, pine-style greenery for a hallway or mantel - 60 cm
5096042277475.sourceDescription:
About 135 green branches form a full 60 cm ring. Its black hanger measures 38 cm, giving the decoration a longer drop from the top of the door and picking up the finish of darker door furniture.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Consider the drop of the hanger as well as the size of the wreath when choosing a door. Hold the two together before positioning them, so the arrangement sits comfortably between the upper panel and the handle.

Fine pine-style sprigs lend themselves to a simple woodland scheme. A plain background keeps the outline of the needles visible, especially where the foliage spreads towards the edge of the decoration. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass.

After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage. On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments.
Full festive appearance with approximately 135 pine-style green branches forming a dense, natural-looking ring.
Includes a contrasting black door hanger measuring 38 cm for elegant vertical display on doors or walls.
Versatile seasonal decoration suitable for hallways, mantels, and entrance areas to enhance holiday ambiance.
Compact 60 cm diameter design fits comfortably in smaller spaces without overwhelming the surrounding decor.
Comes with 4x Router Bits
Hanging rope included

Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The multicoloured finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch.
